name: Academic & Staff Assistance Program
description: The UCSB Academic & Staff Assistance Program (ASAP) supports the health and well-being of faculty, staff, and family members. We assist with identifying, managing, and resolving work-related and personal concerns that may affect job performance and relationships. We offer confidential short-term counseling, consultation, wellness workshops, and assistance with threat management.

name: Chinese Students and Scholars Association
description: Promote cultural exchange, fostering deeper understanding and appreciation of Chinese culture within the university community and creating a welcoming environment for all through diverse social and cultural activities. Represent the whole Chinese student body on campus; try our best to meet their need and make them feel at home; make their college lives more colorful.

name: Freedom 4 Youth Advocates
description: Freedom 4 Youth's mission is to uplift and empower youth to build safe and compassionate communities.

name: Her Campus at UCSB
description: UCSB's Elite level chapter of Her Campus, the #1 online magazine for collegiate women.

name: Pops Orchestra at UCSB
description: To give anyone at UCSB the opportunity to play orchestral music in a casual setting, and a chance to connect and bond with a community of people with shared interests, regardless of skill level.

name: School on Wheels at UCSB
description: School on Wheels is a nonprofit organization dedicated to tutoring K-12 children in underserved and homeless communities. Our chapter at UCSB is looking for passionate and dedicated members to join as general tutors and leadership positions! Additionally, we aim to host school supply drives, fundraiser events, and create education materials for SOW to distribute to other tutors.
